implementation: Reusable Linux PTY helper sets a predictable terminal size, captures the merged terminal transcript and exit code, and kills timed-out child processes.

Real-binary smoke runner covers JSON model inspect, JSON forward probe with a real Torch fixture, and TTY existing-model onboarding. It writes step-level report.json and transcript.txt under target/cli-acceptance by default.

Acceptance matrix traces V0-V3, A0-A13, and CLI-00..CLI-22. Each human workflow separates fixture type, terminal UI evidence, service evidence, and external user/hardware evidence. The runner rejects stale product revision, gate wording/evidence, requirement-status snapshots, workflow references, and CLI task state; release gates remain open.
The --inject-failure option adds an intentional failed assertion after real steps, writes diagnostic artifacts, and returns exit code 1.

validation.result: passed: JSON inspect, JSON probe, and TTY onboarding smoke; report status passed.
